Name: Gazing Mimic
Author: xzcute
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/Lf4ZuFR.png[/img]
[/center]
[center][url=https://smapi.io][img]https://img.shields.io/badge/SMAPI-4.5.0+-brightgreen.svg[/img][/url] [url=https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0][img]https://img.shields.io/badge/License-CC%20BY--NC--SA%204.0-lightgrey.svg[/img][/url] [img]https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Windows%20|%20macOS%20|%20Linux-lightgrey.svg[/img][/center]
[center][size=4]Point this eye at a chest and you can open it from anywhere. The mines, the beach, doesn't matter. Distance means nothing to it.[/size][/center]

[heading][size=5]The Thing[/size][/heading]
[center][quote][i][size=4]"It just knows. Point it at a chest once and it remembers. You can reach through somehow."[/size][/i][/quote][/center]
[size=4]M. Rasmodius was doing a séance and accidentally ripped open reality—life essence and void energy, the wrong combination. Something came through that gap. It watches. It learns. If you ask nicely, it'll act as a shortcut to whatever chest you ask it to remember.[/size]

[heading][size=5]What You Get[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Open chests from anywhere[/b]: Bind it to a storage chest and access it remotely no matter where you are.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]It's alive[/b]: Actually blinks, looks around, changes color based on what chest it's watching. It's a little unsettling.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]No clunky UI[/b]: Just use it like a normal item. The Wizard explains the whole thing when you get it.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Works in multiplayer[/b]: Safe even if two players open the same remote chest at once. Nothing gets lost.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]How to Get It[/size][/heading]
[size=4][b]First one:[/b] Reach 5 hearts with the Wizard. He'll mail you one and the crafting recipe.[/size]
[size=4][b]Make more:[/b] 1 Life Elixir + 5 Void Essence + 5 Hardwood[/size]

[heading][size=5]How to Use It[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Bind it:[/b] Hold it in your inventory and right-click on a chest. Its eye locks on and changes color.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Open remotely:[/b] Middle-click the Mimic in your inventory and you'll see what's inside the chest.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Check status:[/b] Closed eye means it's looking for a target. Weird sounds or rapid blinking means something went wrong (usually the chest got destroyed).[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]Install[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.5.0 or newer[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Extract the folder into Stardew Valley/Mods[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]Compatible With[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4]Stardew 1.6+[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Multiplayer[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]UI scaling and inventory mods[/size][/*]
[/list]
[center][size=4][i]Made by xzqute[/i][/size][/center]
